questions.question: How much does Michał pay for the sick leave on the website zwolnienie.pl?
How many minutes later does he receive the L4 certificate?
questions.explanation: After 15 minutes a PDF with the certificate appears in his inbox.

questions.question: What diagnosis does Michał's fake sick leave have?
questions.explanation: The PDF has the diagnosis "acute upper respiratory tract infection", even though Michał is healthy.

questions.question: What estimated annual cost of sick-leave absences does the text give?
questions.explanation: The text speaks of a cost of 35 billion zlotys to the Polish economy.

questions.question: What does Michał do with the printed sick leave at the end?
answers: He sends it to his boss
He throws it in the bin
He frames it and hangs it
He sends it to the prosecutor's office as evidence
questions.explanation: Michał throws the printed sick leave into the bin — he no longer wants to be part of the problem.
